ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution with a calculated macro-level ratio of approximately 0.15 high-intensity (white) to 0.85 low-intensity pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Mainly solid dark pigmentation. Contiguous lighter grey mottling is visible in the central region of the right lobe. A high-contrast cluster of white geometric blobs is fixed at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 32 degrees; base of the notch is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays 5-7 low-amplitude peaks. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits 9-11 distinct high-amplitude peaks and valleys (jagged serration) isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve on the left lobe and a more irregular, jagged linear trajectory on the right lobe, both tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A dense constellation of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approximately 12-15 discrete spots) localized exclusively on the far right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, vertically oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible in the mid-section of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of white calcified organisms on the distal edge of the right lobe; visible dark linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The asymmetry between the relatively smooth left trailing edge and the highly jagged, barnacle-encrusted right trailing edge serves as a primary unique identifier.
